study: eBOSS DR16 ELG four preselected official FITS.gz image metadata-only inspection
upstream_reference: cheng-zhao/brickmask at commit b9eb684a579b56ec3dbdb46549224be7e3fa2830, io/read_fits.c read_mask requires IMAGE_HDU, NAXIS==2 and CTYPE1=RA---TAN, CTYPE2=DEC--TAN, and read_wcs requires CRVAL1/2, CRPIX1/2, CD1_1, CD1_2, CD2_1, CD2_2
fits_hdu_policy: Accept either nonempty two-dimensional SIMPLE=T primary image, or empty SIMPLE=T primary NAXIS=0 immediately followed by first XTENSION=IMAGE two-dimensional image; do not scan any data-bearing HDU to find an image.
header_validation: Only FITS 80-byte ASCII cards grouped in 2880-byte blocks; parse until END card; max 57600 decompressed header bytes per selected sample combined across at most two headers; test all required numeric WCS values finite, image dimensions positive and bounded by 100000000 pixels, matrix determinant nonzero; report header-block SHA256 and fixed image dimensions/WCS only.
gzip_integrity_scope: Rehash and verify complete original compressed bytes before any gzip opening; gzip reader is asked only for FITS header blocks. It may buffer/decompress additional bytes internally; no pixel byte is returned to application, interpreted or output. No full gzip CRC verification is claimed without reading data payload.
next_gate: After exact local report SHA archive, independently verify complete production code maskbit truth table and per-chunk published ELG data/random contract before expanding image inspection beyond these four samples.
